Ram Temple Trust CEO selection interviews begin

Interviews for the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) position of the Ram Temple Trust commenced on August 11, with 18 candidates shortlisted from over 5,300 applicants. The selection process involves 18 questions for candidates, including inquiries about personal practices like wearing a 'janeu' (sacred thread) and dietary habits. Some reports indicate 20 candidates were shortlisted from 5,200 applications for interviews scheduled for August 11 and 12. Former Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officers are among those interviewed. One individual, Amitabh Thakur, has raised questions about the transparency of the selection process.
